title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 2 Reveals Main Visual and January 9 Premiere Date
content: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 2, the Kaguya Arc , revealed the main anime visual and a January 9, 2027 premiere date. WIT STUDIO is handling the animation for the new adaptation of Gosho Aoyama’s manga, which released its first season last year.
author: Anime Corner

title: Tamil, Telugu Dubs of Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill Anime Stream on Muse India
content: The first anime season premiered by streaming exclusively in Japan on Amazon Prime Video and Hikari TV in January 2023. Muse Asia streamed the first season of the anime in India as it aired in Japan. The Muse India YouTube channel then streamed episodes of the anime with Hindi subtitles in roman script.
author: ANN

title: Indian Delivery Service Blinkit Launches Pokémon Promotional Packaging
content: The packages features 30 different Pokémon including: • Pikachu • Mewtwo • Bulbasaur • Machamp • Squirtle • Charizard • Psyduck • Meowth • Gengar • Jigglypuff • Snorlax • Articuno • Blastoise • Ditto • Arcanine Each package will have a monochrome image featuring a Pokémon with an accompanying Pokémon card-style text.
author: ANN

title: MMAJ Hosts Makoto Shinkai Film Dubbing Competition, Guests Luna Haruna, Daisuke Hasegawa, More in New Delhi
content: The event will take place on October 3 and 4 at Pacific Mall Tagore Garden, New Delhi. The Makoto Shinkai Film Dubbing Competition will take place during both days of the event, but participants must apply online by September 23. Japanese musicians Kanapon, ERIHIRO, and Re: Like will also perform at the event.
author: ANN

title: Muse Asia Licenses Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine Anime
content: Muse Asia announced on Thursday that it has licensed Good Smile Company 's original anime Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine (Beast King War God Dandivine), and will begin streaming it in October. The anime will debut in Japan on October 7.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Streams FX Fighter Kurumi-chan TV Anime
content: Ani-One Asia announced on Friday that it will stream the television anime of storywriter Demunyan and artist Daisuki Tansan 's FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ( FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ) manga in October. The anime will debut in Japan on October 1.
author: ANN

title: Sanrio's Fragaria Memories: Color of Wishes Smartphone Game Gets Worldwide Release in Fall 2027
content: Sanrio announced on Saturday its Fragaria Memories: Color of Wishes smartphone game will get a worldwide release for iOS and Android in fall 2027. The company is streaming a new promotional video for the game. The game will be free to play with optional in-app purchases.
author: ANN

title: ATASHIn'CHI Next Net Anime Gets New Episodes
content: Shinei Animation announced at the ABEMA Anime Matsuri 2026 event on Saturday that ATASHIn'CHI Next , the latest net anime for the ATASHIn'CHI franchise, will get a new batch of episodes. Taku Kimura ( Chainsmoker Cat ) will direct the anime.
author: ANN

title: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery New Images Reveal First Look at Nishagora
content: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery , the first installment in the franchise’s new theatrical film series, revealed new scene stills, including the first look at the new character Nishagora. The anime is set to premiere in Japan on October 23, 2026. You can see the new images below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Tenth Ending Featuring "Sakura Rock" by CHERRYBLOSSOM
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its tenth ending, featuring the song “Sakura Rock” by CHERRYBLOSSOM. The song was used in Episodes 115-126, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner
